description: Permissions for the SecuraCV Flasher main window: open dialogs and external docs, and post notifications. Deliberately NO shell permission: every espflash/rpiboot sidecar spawn happens Rust-side (launch_guard::spawn_tracked via ShellExt), which the webview capability system does not gate — so granting the webview shell:allow-execute only widened what an injected script could do. The same rule now applies to updater:default and process:default: self-update and relaunch are driven from Rust (install_update), and the frontend only ever calls core / dialog / event / notification / app, so the webview grants match exactly what desktop/src/app.js uses.
